none: PAS NLM-A29C4F: Roman Coin: Denarius of Caracalla
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius; probably of Caracalla (198-217) as Caesar (195-198). Sear vol. 2 no. 6676 suggest an identification, citing RIC vol. 4 part 1 no. 12, issue of 196-198. Obverse description: Youthful bust with spikey hair, possibly rams' horns, draped, right. Obverse inscription: M AVR [----] CAES PON[TIF]. Reverse description: Female figure standing right with left hand raise holding object…
